types.comment: Singleton: SMissionManager::Construct b8ff0 does operator new(0x1c70) + ctor b8c30 and stores it in global 0x239220 (Destruct b9060 deletes it). No vptr. Xbox uses MSVC std::list (12 bytes) for objectives/messages/rule lists where PS2 uses bare pointers, so the Xbox front is larger; later bools pack to 1 byte.
